data.title: Bescheid für 2025 über Einkommensteuer
data.summary: The Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025, setting the tax at €4,311.00 and granting a refund (Guthaben) of €715.00, to be transferred to the recipient's account.
data.explanation: This is your official 2025 income tax assessment. The tax office calculated your tax and found you overpaid, so €715.00 will be refunded to your account automatically — no action needed for that. If you disagree with any part of the calculation (for example, the rejected home office room costs), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Finanzamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the assessment becomes final and binding after the deadline passes.
data.tax_note: This document is itself the 2025 income tax assessment; keep it for your records as proof of the tax calculation and refund.

remedy.period_text: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielgüstrow eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether you want to object to this tax assessment and, if so, submit the objection in writing, via the ELSTER portal, or orally for the record at the Finanzamt by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final and you lose the right to challenge it.
